facts.projectSummary:
## MPG Site Records — App Plan

**Company:** My Project Group Ltd
**Concept:** A native iOS/iPad app that replaces messy WhatsApp invoices, PDFs and photos with one standard company system for construction subcontractors. Tradesmen log allocated work, take photos, upload receipts, complete daily site records and submit weekly invoices/timesheets. Admin (Steve) and site managers review, approve, query and pay.

**Platform scope note:** 10x builds native iOS (iPhone + iPad), not web/Android/desktop browser. Delivered as a native iOS app covering the same functionality.

### v1 Status — COMPLETE (mock/local-first)
Role-based entry with mock auth (Admin / Site Manager / Tradesman). All three role experiences built and navigable end to end. Site Files Hub, geofenced clock-in/out, and Attendance overview shipped.

---

## NEXT FEATURE — Offline Work Logging (scoping)

**Why:** Tradesmen on site often have no reliable connectivity (basements, rural sites, steel-frame buildings, poor signal). Right now every log action assumes data is saved instantly to the in-memory store. On a real backend that means lost daily records, photos, materials, and clock-ins when signal drops. The app must let a tradesman capture everything offline and sync it automatically once back online, with clear status so nothing is silently lost.

### What must work offline
- **Daily site records** — write/edit fully offline.
- **Materials / receipts** — add offline with captured photo.
- **Site photos & file uploads** — captured and queued; binary stored locally until upload.
- **Geofenced clock-in / clock-out

metadata.appStoreDescription:
MPG Site Records replaces messy WhatsApp threads, loose photos and one-off PDFs with one standard company system for construction subcontractors and the office that pays them.

Built for tradesmen working on real sites, the app keeps the whole week in order. See the work you have been allocated, complete daily site records, capture before, during and after photos, log materials and receipts, clock in and out with GPS geofencing, and submit your weekly timesheet and invoice when the job is done.

For the office, admins and site managers get a single dashboard to review submissions, chase missing receipts, query hours, approve work and pay on time.

FOR TRADESMEN

Today's Work shows every allocated job with address, hours, trade and what is required on site.

Job Details keeps the brief, times, site manager and notes from the office together, with quick actions to take a photo, add materials or submit a daily record.

Daily Site Records capture start time, finish time, breaks, work carried out and any delays, with the day's total hours calculated automatically.

Photos are timestamped and linked to the job automatically, sorted as before, during or after works.

Materials and receipts are filed against the right job so nothing goes missing before invoicing.

Weekly invoices show net due, hours and CIS deductions, with clear draft and paid status and the Monday submission deadline in view.

Your profile holds trade and business details plus compliance information including UTR, NI number, CIS status and VAT.

FOR ADMINS AND SITE MANAGERS

The Office Dashboard shows invoices to review, active tradesmen, active sites and total outstanding at a glance.

Clear alerts flag materials purchases missing a receipt and invoices submitted after the deadline, so problems are caught before payment runs.

Sites and the tradesmen working them stay organised in one place, ready to review, query, approve and pay.

WHY TEAMS USE IT

One standard system for every job, instead of scattered messages and files.

Honest daily records and GPS clock-ins that hold up when it matters.

Photos and receipts filed by job, ready at invoice time.

Faster review and payment for the office.

MPG Site Records is built for My Project Group Ltd and the subcontractors who work with them.

reviewNotes: This app is for authorised subcontractors and staff of My Project Group Ltd only. Account creation is not open to the public; access requires credentials issued by the company.
A demo tradesman account and a demo admin account are available for review — see the demo account checklist below.
The app uses location only when the user actively clocks in, clocks out, or uploads site evidence. There is no background location tracking.
Camera and photo library permissions are used to capture and attach site photos and supplier receipts to job records.
GPS geofencing is used to confirm the user is near the allocated job site at clock-in and clock-out.
The Apple Sign In entitlement is present as an additional authentication option alongside Supabase Auth email/password login.
Associated Domains entitlement supports universal links to deep-link into specific job or invoice records.

Note: credentials for both tradesman and admin demo accounts must be confirmed with the contact above before submitting for review.

intro: This Privacy Policy explains how My Project Group Ltd ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you use the MPG Site Records application ("the App"). By using the App you agree to the practices described here.
If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at info@my-project.co.uk.

bullets: Account information: your name, email address, trade, business details, and compliance information such as UTR number, National Insurance number, CIS status, and VAT registration.
Daily site records: start and finish times, break durations, work descriptions, delays, and calculated hours.
Photos: timestamped images taken with your device camera or selected from your photo library, categorised as before, during, or after works.
Materials and receipts: descriptions, costs, and photographs of supplier receipts submitted against a job.

Location data: a single location reading captured at the moment you clock in, clock out, or upload site evidence — used solely to confirm proximity to the allocated site. Location is not tracked continuously in the background.
Invoice and payment data: hours worked, net amounts due, and CIS deduction records.
Device and usage data: app interaction events and crash diagnostics collected via analytics services to help us improve the App.
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly and information generated by your use of the App.
sections.title: Information We Collect

bullets: To provide and operate the App, including authenticating your account and synchronising records between your device and our servers.
To allow site managers and administrators to review, query, approve, and pay submitted timesheets and invoices.
To confirm site attendance through GPS-verified clock-in and clock-out.
To generate and display weekly invoices showing hours, net due, and CIS deductions.
To send alerts about missing receipts or late invoice submissions.
To improve App performance and reliability using aggregated analytics and crash-diagnostic data.
To comply with applicable legal and contractual obligations.
paragraphs: We use the information we collect for the following purposes.
sections.title: How We Use Information

bullets: Camera: used to photograph work progress and capture supplier receipts on site.
Photo Library (read): used to attach existing photos and receipts from your device library to a job or daily record.
Photo Library (add): used to save site photos you capture in the App back to your device library.
Location (when in use): a single reading taken only when you clock in, clock out, or submit site evidence. Location is not accessed in the background.
paragraphs: The App requests the following device permissions. You may manage these in your iOS Settings at any time; revoking a permission will limit the relevant App functionality.
sections.title: Device Permissions And Sensitive Data

bullets: Within your organisation: information you submit is visible to the administrators and site managers of My Project Group Ltd who are responsible for reviewing and approving your records.

Service providers: we use Supabase to host and authenticate account data, and analytics tools to monitor App performance. These providers process data on our behalf under appropriate data-processing arrangements.
OpenAI: certain features may use OpenAI's API to process text you submit within the App. No personally identifiable financial or compliance data is intentionally sent to OpenAI.
Legal obligations: we may disclose information where required to do so by law or in response to a valid legal request.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information in the following limited circumstances.
sections.title: How We Share Information

paragraphs: We retain your account and job records for as long as your account remains active or as required to fulfil our legal and contractual obligations, including CIS and construction industry record-keeping requirements.
If you wish to request deletion of your data, please contact us at info@my-project.co.uk. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe and advise you of any records we are required to retain by law.
sections.title: Data Retention

paragraphs: You may update your profile information within the App at any time. You may also contact us at info@my-project.co.uk to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, subject to our legal retention obligations.
You can manage device permissions (camera, photo library, location) in iOS Settings. Revoking permissions will disable the corresponding App features but will not affect previously submitted records.

paragraphs: The App is intended for use by construction industry tradesmen, subcontractors, site managers, and administrators. It is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
